hypotheses.rationale_with_citations: Both are Capitol Hill residential burglaries on consecutive days, THU 04DEC and FRI 05DEC, during daytime windows. In each, entry was made by prying a rear slider or sliding door, leaving pry marks on the frame [CC-25-000158:narrative] [CC-25-000165:narrative]. The property taken is nearly the same: cash, an Aldane K14 laptop and a cell phone [CC-25-000158:items] [CC-25-000165:items]. Both also share the same behaviour: the MBR was ransacked and a safe was targeted [CC-25-000158:narrative] [CC-25-000165:narrative].

Both are daytime Mount Baker residential burglaries where entry was through the rear door with a key/code and no force [CC-25-000341:narrative] [CC-26-000485:narrative]. Both losses include a white Kestrel Ultra 16 laptop and a Sonique TV 55in [CC-25-000341:items] [CC-26-000485:items]. Both share the same signatures: the MBR was ransacked with drawers dumped, and the doorbell cam was unplugged or covered [CC-25-000341:narrative] [CC-26-000485:narrative]. CC-25-000077, also in Mount Baker, is left out because it differs: the rear door was kicked in and only cameras were taken [CC-25-000077:narrative].

Both are daytime detached-garage burglaries in SLU/Cascade, three days apart (TUE 13JAN and FRI 16JAN). In each, entry was made by smashing the garage door glass [CC-26-000413:narrative] [CC-26-000431:narrative]. Each loss pairs a Cyclade bicycle with one electronics item [CC-26-000413:items] [CC-26-000431:items]. The doorbell cam was unplugged or covered at both scenes [CC-26-000413:narrative] [CC-26-000431:narrative].

Both are SODO detached-garage burglaries on Thursday evenings (29JAN and 12FEB). In each, entry was through a window with a key/code and no force [CC-26-000491:narrative] [CC-26-000553:narrative]. Each loss includes a Cyclade bicycle, power tools and a carried item, either a backpack or a luggage set [CC-26-000491:items] [CC-26-000553:items]. At both scenes electronics were left behind and a safe was targeted [CC-26-000491:narrative] [CC-26-000553:narrative].
